scope: 43 interactive items: 10 build lists, 16 matching items and 17 dropdown items; compared with all 359 local source questions, including the 341 active questions.
method: Lexical candidate ranking followed by manual comparison of required decisions, answer keys and case constraints. Similarity alone is not treated as a duplicate. Source IDs are stable data IDs, not shuffled screen numbers.

nearDuplicates.reason: Revision mode and weighted traffic repeat the same deployment decision.
Both choose Key Vault with managed identity for Container Apps secrets.
Same connection exhaustion scenario and PgBouncer remedy; adds its port.
Same separation of ordinary configuration and secrets; adds examples.

partialOverlaps.reason: Same identity and AcrPull pattern, different hosting platform.
Repeats queue-driven scale-to-zero; adds a replica ceiling and case constraints.
Change feed overlap; additionally tests processor coordination.
Adds component responsibilities and feed mode.
Overlapping vector schema knowledge, different answer granularity.
Combines payload filtering, retention and retry limits.
Adds time filtering and grouped aggregation to failure filtering.
Similar aggregation pipeline, different grouping and output requirements.

result: No verbatim duplicates found. Four near-duplicates and nine partial overlaps are reported separately. No MightyBS question text was imported; reuse permission was not established. The new local interactive bank is independently authored.
limitations: A manual semantic review is not a mathematical guarantee. Shared terminology alone does not imply equivalent questions. Recheck if either source bank changes.
